title: Graphic Design Fundamentals
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: GRAPHIC DESIGN FUNDAMENTALS — Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Gain a solid understanding of fundamental design principles.
Be proficient in typography, color theory, and composition, using industry-standard design software.
Effectively communicate messages through graphic design including developing projects for portfolio building, preparing them for advanced studies or careers in design-related fields.

notes: Required courses are printed under 'SEMESTER I' and 'SEMESTER II' subheadings; recorded as one 'all' block. Block stated 18 taken from the text '18 units of Required Courses'.

The catalog prints 3 units for each course, while the state file stores 2 units each; catalog titles also differ from the closed list (e.g., VISCOM 129 'Adobe Photoshop' vs 'Digital Photo Manipulation', VISCOM 118 'Adobe Illustrator' vs 'Digital Drawing', VISCOM 112 'Design History and Production' vs 'Digital Prepress II'). Reviewer should verify.

The PLOs are printed once for the program with the lead-in 'Upon completion of the Degree/Certificate program'; this certificate shares that list. A line-break hyphen in 'industry-standard' was kept as one hyphenated word.
The program overview includes sentences about a 'Game Art & Design Foundation program' (3D modeling, game engines) that appear to belong to a different program; not used for requirements.
Header line 'T046498D C 18 - 18' matches the 18 Major Units stated.
Page 186 content (Sign Graphics, Screen Printing Fundamentals) belongs to other programs and was not used.
